title: Reflectors and the Globalization Problem for Partial Actions of Semiconstellations
summary: We introduce semiconstellations and restriction semiconstellations, together with their actions on sets, providing a common setting for partial actions of categories, inverse semigroupoids, restriction semigroups, and semigroupoids. We then investigate the \emph{globalization problem}, which asks whether every partial action can, up to isomorphism, be obtained by restricting a global action.
